subject: ela
intro: Determine multiple themes and summarize objectively.

items.prompt:
A complex literary text often carries:
A) two or more interacting themes
B) no theme at all
C) only a title
items.answer: A) two or more interacting themes

solution.answer: A) two or more interacting themes

items.prompt:
An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) states key events without opinion
B) adds your judgment
C) is very long
items.answer: A) states key events without opinion

solution.answer: A) states key events without opinion

items.prompt:
Two themes in a text can:
A) interact and build on one another
B) never relate
C) only repeat the title
items.answer: A) interact and build on one another

solution.answer: A) interact and build on one another

items.prompt:
Read.

A soldier returns a hero but is haunted by nightmares his family cannot understand.

Two themes are:
A) war's hidden cost and the isolation it creates
B) only that war is fun
C) only that families are large
items.answer: A) war's hidden cost and the isolation it creates

steps: Two interacting themes. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) war's hidden cost and the isolation it creates

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary of that passage?
A) A tragic, broken hero was cruelly abandoned by his clueless family.
B) A soldier returns honored but haunted, and his family cannot grasp what he endured.
C) This is a heartbreaking story.
items.answer: B) A soldier returns honored but haunted, and his family cannot grasp what he endured.

solution.answer: B) A soldier returns honored but haunted, and his family cannot grasp what he endured.

items.prompt:
When two themes INTERACT, they:
A) reinforce, complicate, or deepen one another
B) cancel each other out
C) have no effect
items.answer: A) reinforce, complicate, or deepen one another

solution.answer: A) reinforce, complicate, or deepen one another

items.prompt:
Read.

The inventor's genius brought the world light, but his obsession cost him his family and his health.

Two interacting themes are BEST stated as:
A) The gifts of genius and the personal price of obsession.
B) Inventors are smart.
C) Light bulbs are useful.
items.answer: A) The gifts of genius and the personal price of obsession.

steps: Two themes that interact. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) The gifts of genius and the personal price of obsession.

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary?
A) The settlers built a town and later abandoned it.
B) The foolish settlers tragically wasted their efforts on a doomed, miserable town.
C) They moved west afterward.
items.answer: B) The foolish settlers tragically wasted their efforts on a doomed, miserable town.

solution.answer: B) The foolish settlers tragically wasted their efforts on a doomed, miserable town.
